Task: Explain why the sky appears blue, in three sentences.

steps.action:
The sky appears blue because of a phenomenon called Rayleigh scattering, in which sunlight interacts with the gas molecules in Earth's atmosphere. Sunlight contains all colors of the visible spectrum, but shorter wavelengths of light (blue and violet) are scattered much more effectively by atmospheric molecules than longer wavelengths (red and orange). Although violet light is scattered even more than blue, our eyes are more sensitive to blue light and some violet is absorbed in the upper atmosphere, so the sky ultimately appears blue to us.
